findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment:
The preparation cooler is observed to have an ambient temperature of 52F in the bottom. The PIC stated that Falcon Restaurant Company replaced the control board in the preparation cooler yesterday. The following TCS food items were probed and discarded if above 41F:

1. A container of pepper jack cheese probed to be at 46.6F. 
2. A container of provolone cheese probed to be at 50F. 
3. A container of turkey probed to be at 47.3F. 
4. A container of ham probed to be at 49.9F. 
5. A container of butter probed to be at 46F. 

The owner voluntarily discarded these TCS food items and contacted Falcon to repair the cooler. The facility has multiple other coolers available to cold hold TCS food items in. A spot check will be conducted on 8/4/2026 to ensure that the preparation cooler is repaired and is properly cold holding at 41F and below.
findings.citation_text: 3-501.16(A)(2) Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding. (A) Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as the public health control as specified under §3-501.19, and except as specified under (B) and in (C) of this section, TIME/TEMPERATURE CONTROL FOR SAFETY FOOD shall be maintained:(2) At 5°C (41°F) or less.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures.
findings.comment:
The back preparation cooler is observed to have an ambient temperature of 45F in the bottom of the cooler. The following food items in the cooler were probed: 

1. A container of ham probed to be at 47F. 
2. A container of turkey probed to be at 48F. 
3. A container of turkey probed to be at 46F. 
4. A container of provolone cheese probed to be at 47F. 
5. A bottle of opened Italian dressing probed to be at 50F. 
6. A container of american cheese probed to be at 51F. 
7. A container of cream cheese probed to be at 49F. 
8. 2 boxes of cream cheese cups probed to be at 51F and 53F. 

CORRECTED- All TCS foods probed to be above 41F were voluntarily discarded by the owner. The facility has multiple other coolers that are properly cold holding at 41F and below and have space to cold hold their TCS food items. The PIC stated that they will be repairing this cooler to allow it to properly cold hold. A spot check will be conducted on 7/31/2026 to ensure that the cooler is properly cold holding at 41F and below.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: There was not a temporary handwashing station available and the facility is scooping ice for drinks. The PIC stated that they were going to use the bathrooms, but the sinks in the bathroom were not working. It was discussed with the PIC that the bathroom sinks are not close enough to be suitable for handwashing. CORRECTED- A temporary handwashing station was set up. Ensure that there is always a handwashing station set up when doing a temporary set-up at an event.
findings.citation_text: 5-203.11(A) Handwashing Sinks. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, at least 1 HANDWASHING SINK, a number of HANDWASHING SINKS necessary for their convenient use by EMPLOYEES in areas specified under § 5-204.11, and not fewer than the number of HANDWASHING SINKS required by LAW shall be provided.
